en.body:
#### Register now and gain valuable expert insights into the successful implementation of alpine PV systems.

In this webinar, you'll experience alpine PV systems from three perspectives simultaneously: technical, social, and grid-related. You'll learn how projects are realized under alpine conditions, which political and social factors determine acceptance, and what is crucial for secure grid integration. Gain in-depth knowledge, concrete challenges, and proven solutions that you can directly apply to your decisions, planning, and projects.

In this webinar, you'll learn about alpine PV systems from three perspectives simultaneously: technical, social, and grid-related.

#### 🗓️ January 19, 2026 │ 🕐 11:40–12:50 │ 💬 German

11:40–11:45: Welcome (Christof Bucher, BFH)

11:45–12:05: Technical Research Findings (Michael Lehning, EPFL)

11:55–12:05: Sociopolitical Research Findings (Isabelle Stadelmann-Steffen, UNIBE)

12:05–12:15: Industry Perspective (Andreas Hügli, REECH AG)

12:15–12:50: Panel & Discussion
